messages.content:
Diagnosis:
The failure occurs in the test `testEscapedQuote_LANG_477()` which tries to create a new ExtendedMessageFormat instance with a pattern containing escaped single quotes ("it''s a {0,lower} 'test'!"). According to the current bug report, using ExtendedMessageFormat with a custom format registry and a pattern containing single quotes triggers an OutOfMemoryError.

Looking at the constructor ExtendedMessageFormat(String pattern, Map registry), it delegates to the constructor ExtendedMessageFormat(String pattern, Locale locale, Map registry) with Locale.getDefault(). In this second constructor, it saves the registry map and then calls applyPattern(pattern).

In applyPattern(String pattern), if there is a non-null registry (custom format registry), the code attempts to parse the pattern manually, distinguishing quoted strings, format elements, and custom formats to apply. During parsing, it uses appendQuotedString to parse quoted strings within the pattern.

The method appendQuotedString handles escaped quotes and quoted sections. It scans through the pattern substring checking for escaped quotes (two single quotes ''). If found, it appends one quote ('). If not, it keeps reading until it finds a closing quote.

In the test's pattern, the segment "it''s a {0,lower} 'test'!" contains both escaped single quotes and quoted text. The bug report suggests that when this pattern is used alongside a custom format registry, there is an OutOfMemoryError.

The likely source of the problem is in applyPattern's parsing loop combined with appendQuotedString's handling of quoted strings. Specifically, in applyPattern there's a loop over the pattern's characters, and when encountering a quote character (case QUOTE), it calls appendQuotedString. This method advances the ParsePosition over the quoted section.

If appendQuotedString or the surrounding loop in applyPattern does not correctly advance the ParsePosition or mishandles the quoted strings with escaped quotes, it can cause an infinite loop or repeated processing of the same substring.

This infinite loop would repeatedly append to StringBuffer stripCustom, leading to uncontrolled memory growth and eventually OutOfMemoryError.

In summary, the parsing logic for escaped single quotes in applyPattern combined with appendQuotedString is faulty when a custom format registry is used, resulting in infinite looping and exhaustion of memory.

The recent bug reports do not appear related.

Hence, the root cause is the bug in ExtendedMessageFormat.applyPattern and/or appendQuotedString in handling patterns with escaped quotes and a custom format registry, leading to infinite loops and OutOfMemoryError.

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
